    No saccade detected: 0/120 = 0% of trials

    Corrective saccade after it: 0/120 = 0% of trials
      same detection in fixation before the go cue (chance level): 0/120 = 0%

  Return leg: no return jump

  Degrees: symbols 35.9 deg apart on an assumed 1.78:1 screen, PLACEHOLDER screen geometry,
    from screen height and viewing distance, scaled by each run's calibration.
  Peak velocity is approximate and reads low: 200 Hz Neon samples, speed from a 3-sample smoothed trace.
  Corrective: a further saccade of 4-50% of the first one's size, starting 20-400 ms after it ends;
    noise, blinks and fixational movements count too, so compare it with the chance level (not validated on glasses).
  A saccade is a movement of at least the minimum amplitude (Technical details); tracking loss counts as no saccade.
